title: The sixth condition of Salah – the niyyah
intro: The niyyah is the decision in the heart about which prayer we are praying.

learn.html: The sixth condition of Salah is the niyyah – deciding to pray. The niyyah is a conscious decision in the heart: why and for whom we are doing something. Before Salah we must know which prayer we want to pray.
We can strengthen the niyyah in the heart by saying its words. Every prayer has its own niyyah. When we say it, we turn our thoughts to Allah:

learn.label: The start of every niyyah
learn.en: I intend to pray, for Allah, the Most High…

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: Muhammad (SAW) said: “Deeds are judged by intentions, and every person gets what they intended…” (Bukhari and Muslim)

items: a clean body, clothes and place

questions.q: What is the sixth condition of Salah?
How are deeds judged, according to the hadith?
